name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Coordinated Russian intelligence operations conducting arson, maritime drone strikes, targeted assassination plots, and Starlink ground station sabotage across Poland, the Baltics, and the Black Sea littoral.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actors exploiting an unauthenticated three-flaw zero-day chain (including CVE-2026-104935) to obtain remote root code execution on edge VPN gateways.

name: DPRK Remote Worker Infiltration (Operation Lonestar Roundup)
